sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 707 physical subject rows / 701 family-card identities across 18 sections are reconciled. Both 1986 Topps headings are captions, restoring the separate 40-card insert and ten-card autograph programs rather than counting the headings as cards. Both 100-card base lists remain separate; repeated dual codes retain both subjects. Base card 37 Jack Hughes and card 137 Aaron Pike retain their printed identities. The source publishes names but no team, athlete-sport or rookie field; none are inferred from Team USA branding. All 85 odds categories retain three original columns and literal cells, including nulls, Hobby Base Green 01:23:00 and repeated Silver Silver / Gold Gold Dynasty wording. The sheet does not state a ratio unit; no pack rates are computed. Both base sections share explicitly aliased Base odds. Pink Refractors /250 remains a qualified product-guide statement without an exact family join; no other colors receive inferred limits. Product Year 2025 and January 15, 2026 U.S. store availability remain separate from the checklist title and an unverified general release date. Exhaustive parallel numbering remains unconfirmed.
The guide's Pink Refractors /250 statement does not explicitly identify a checklist family; exact family-scoped numbering remains unreconciled.
Other serial limits and an exhaustive parallel inventory remain unverified. Product images and color names alone do not establish numbering.
The odds sheet names Hobby-146, Value Box SE-148 and Value Box EA-147 but no ratio unit. Preserve all 85 categories and 255 original cells, including nulls and the literal Hobby Base Green 01:23:00.
January 15, 2026 is U.S. store availability, not a verified general release announcement. Neither Team USA branding nor athlete identities establish per-card teams, sports or rookie fields.
